1.description: LaDe Hangzhou V2 B1 reference costing, researched 2026-09-30. Mixed-year public proxies, not observed LaDe operating accounts or a 2026 supplier quotation. Diesel light-vehicle counterfactual in both layers. Distance = fuel + assumed maintenance; work = allocated wage; vehicle = assumed non-labor fixed cost. B1 pool lifetime is operating cycles; the 50-use interpretation requires N=Q. Full return and no loss. See evidence_file for every assumption.

claim: Conditional scenario arithmetic; not an empirical profitability proof.
assumptions: Identical repeated demand and service windows each cycle
Same forward packaging weight and volume in all models
Full pool replaced after the stated number of cycles; no random losses
No discounting, financing, inflation or salvage value
Distance-optimal or heuristic routes, not cost-optimal routes
Earliest fixed-route schedules; no work-time minimization
